name: Titanium.Platform.Android
summary: The Android-specific Platform module, used to access the device's platform-related functionality.

properties.name: API_LEVEL
properties.summary: Android API level identifier of the Operating System.
properties.description:
See the official Android Developers documentation for more information about 
[API levels](https://developer.android.com/guide/appendix/api-levels.html).

properties.name: PHYSICAL_SIZE_CATEGORY_LARGE

properties.description:
See the official Android Developers documentation for more information about
[large screen sizes](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/content/res/Configuration.html#SCREENLAYOUT_SIZE_LARGE)
